note: MOD_PLAN.md section 5 (host tuning A/B): the daily preset against itself on the same binary, so the arms never differ. The HOST differs between runs: tools/pancake/host_tune_ab.sh applies one tools/pancake/host_tune.sh step (nvme_ra, thp, swappiness, cpu_perf, amd_pstate, gpu_dpm, aspm, cstate, or all), runs this spec at --tier screen, reverts the step, and writes /home/dan/auto-runs/winH-<step>.stdout; a baseline run (no step) comes first and last. Judge a step by its base arm against the baseline's base arm; the base-again arm of the same file is that file's noise floor and drift_check flags a base-vs-base-again gap. Cases: short and edit = decode tok/s, long1k and long3k = prompt tok/s of a cold prompt (the first-token cost of a cold prompt; abtest has no separate cold-load case, the cold pack load is timed by tools/pancake/load_time.py inside host_tune_ab.sh for the NVMe step). No STRATA_* switch is used, so spec_lint has nothing to check. Stop pancake.service first (host_tune_ab.sh does it after 3 idle minutes).
